correctness.rationale: Harmonic minimum principles reduce the target infimum to boundary behavior. Near the singular point z=1 the expansion and the disk half-plane inequality for 1/(1-z) give lower limit about 0.8804, well above the candidate. Conjugation symmetry reduces the regular boundary to (0,pi). The inspected interval verifier certifies negative derivative up to 1.8086448, positive derivative from 1.8086449 to pi-0.1, and positive second derivative on the root bracket; analytic endpoint bounds remain above 0.57. Fresh high-precision solving reproduced the stated critical point and value. Subordination transfers the infimum to every class member, and the canonical equality-subordination solution approaches the minimizing boundary value, proving sharpness.
